placements.why: Establishes the foundational organizational strata for instrument calibration governance, history, and record maintenance in the absence of prior strata.
placements.title: governance and integrity of instrument calibration records
placements.frame: How does the organization govern, verify, and revise the historical record of instrument calibrations?

placements.title: authoritative erasure and repudiation of historical instrument calibrations
placements.frame: Under what conditions and authority are historical instrument calibrations and contributor records directed to be expunged from institutional memory?
placements.why: All three segments collectively mandate the complete removal and disavowal of historical calibration work, specific frequencies (88.4 MHz), named contributors (Quill Ashgrove), and the spectrograph's calibration history.
